toolsPreview.name: find_copyable_traders
toolsPreview.description: List Hyperliquid traders that are actually copyable AND realizable for a follower, pre-gated by copy-lag decay, de-leverage, and alpha-vs-beta (NOT raw leaderboard PnL). Returns copyability tier, Realizability Score 0-100, risk grade, PnL, return, copy-lag tolerance. Use when you need vetted copy candidates, not noisy 'top trader' lists.
